independent_audit.scope: Read-only source/build/harness/runner audit plus independent raw sample, first-call exclusion, median/range and signed-change recalculation; source git bytes, SHA256/FNV, executable/library/harness/shim/Cargo hashes and real round-order checks.

scope_limits: Diagnosis/report construction only; excludes real evaluation, JSON verification and report destruction.
Repeated same-snapshot calls are not the entire Worker path with one diagnostic per new revision.
Shared-host idleness is not guaranteed; no statistical-significance claim.
Whole-process CPU and peak RSS combine all API paths and are not per-path memory.
No cancellation-latency, GUI-responsiveness, CAD-evaluation-speedup or zero-overhead claim.
